# Census Data
## Age trends over time
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
print(
  census_data_overall_long %>%
    filter(DemographicType == 'Age',
           !(Demographic %in% c('Under 5 Years', '5 to 9 Years'))) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = Population/TotalPopulation,
           Demographic = Demographic %>% factor(levels=c(
        'Under 5 Years', '5 to 9 Years', '10 to 14 Years',
        '15 to 19 Years', '20 to 24 Years', '25 to 34 Years',
        '35 to 44 Years', '45 to 54 Years', '55 to 59 Years',
        '60 to 64 Years', '65 to 74 Years', '75 to 84 Years', 
        '85 Years and Over'
      ))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=Proportion, color=Demographic)) +
    geom_line() +
    theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = 11)) +
    labs(y='Population Proportion', color='Age Group') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
    ggtitle('Distribution of Age Groups in Relevant LA ZIP Codes')
)

print(
  collisions_cleaned %>%
    filter(!is.na(VictimAge)) %>%
    mutate(AgeGroup = case_when(
      VictimUnder5Years ~ 'Under 5 Years',
      Victim5to9Years ~ '5 to 9 Years',
      Victim10to14Years ~ '10 to 14 Years',
      Victim15to19Years ~ '15 to 19 Years',
      Victim20to24Years ~ '20 to 24 Years',
      Victim25to34Years ~ '25 to 34 Years',
      Victim35to44Years ~ '35 to 44 Years',
      Victim45to54Years ~ '45 to 54 Years',
      Victim55to59Years ~ '55 to 59 Years',
      Victim60to64Years ~ '60 to 64 Years',
      Victim65to74Years ~ '65 to 74 Years',
      Victim75to84Years ~ '75 to 84 Years',
      Victim85YearsAndOver ~ '85 Years and Over') %>% factor(levels=c(
        'Under 5 Years', '5 to 9 Years', '10 to 14 Years',
        '15 to 19 Years', '20 to 24 Years', '25 to 34 Years',
        '35 to 44 Years', '45 to 54 Years', '55 to 59 Years',
        '60 to 64 Years', '65 to 74 Years', '75 to 84 Years', 
        '85 Years and Over'
      ))
    ) %>%
    group_by(OccurredYear) %>% mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    group_by(OccurredYear, AgeGroup) %>% summarise(Proportion=n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=OccurredYear, y=Proportion, color=AgeGroup)) +
    geom_line() +
    theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = 11)) +
    labs(y='Proportion of Collisions', color='Victim Age') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
    ggtitle('Distribution of Collisions by Victim Age')
)
```

## Race/ethnicity trends over time
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
print(
  census_data_overall_long %>%
    filter(DemographicType == 'Race or Ethnicity') %>%
    mutate(Proportion = Population/TotalPopulation,
           Demographic = Demographic %>% factor(levels=c(
             'Asian', 'Black', 'Hispanic', 'Indigenous', 'Pacific Islander', 
             'White Non-Hispanic', 'Two or More Races', 'Other Race'
      ))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=Proportion, color=Demographic)) +
    geom_line() +
    theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = 11)) +
    labs(y='Population Proportion', color='Race/Ethnicity') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
    ggtitle('Distribution of Race/Ethnicity in Relevant LA ZIP Codes',
            subtitle='Note: Hispanic Ethnicity is not mutually exclusive with any Race in census data')
)

print(
  collisions_cleaned %>% 
    mutate(VictimEthnicity = VictimEthnicity %>% factor(levels=c(
             'Asian', 'Black', 'Hispanic', 'Indigenous', 
             'Pacific Islander', 'White', 'Other'
      ))) %>%
    group_by(OccurredYear) %>% mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    group_by(OccurredYear, VictimEthnicity) %>% summarise(Proportion=n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=OccurredYear, y=Proportion, color=VictimEthnicity)) +
    geom_line() +
    theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = 11)) +
    labs(y='Proportion of Collisions', color='Victim Race/Ethnicity') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
    ggtitle('Distribution of Collisions by Victim Race/Ethnicity',
            subtitle='Hispanic Ethnicity is mutually exclusive with Race in collisions data')
)
```

## Map of collisions by race/ethnicity
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
for (race in c('Asian', 'Black', 'Hispanic', 'White')) {
  print(
    collisions_cleaned %>%
      filter(Latitude != 0, Longitude != 0, 
             Latitude %>% between(33.6, 34.4),
             Longitude %>% between(-118.7, -118.1),
             VictimEthnicity == local(race)) %>%
      group_by(Latitude = round(Latitude, 3), Longitude = round(Longitude, 3), VictimEthnicity) %>%
      summarise(Collisions = n()) %>%
      arrange(Collisions) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude, color=Collisions)) +
      geom_point() +
      xlim(-118.7, -118.1) +
      ylim(33.6, 34.4) +
      ggtitle(paste('Collision Density Map for ', local(race), ' Victims', sep=''))
  )
}
```

# Commutes over Time
## Commuting trends over time
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
# Proportion of each mode of transportation over time
print(
  commuting_data_long %>%
    filter(!(CommuterType %in% c('Approximate Number of Cars', 'Non-Car'))) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = round(Commuters/TotalCommuters, 2)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=Proportion, color=CommuterType)) +
    geom_line() +
    theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = 11)) +
    labs(color='Mode of Transportation') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent)
)

print(
  commuting_data_by_sex_long %>%
    filter(!(CommuterType %in% c('Approximate Number of Cars', 'Non-Car'))) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = round(Commuters/DemographicCommuters, 2)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=Proportion, color=CommuterType)) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(~Demographic) +
    theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = 11)) +
    labs(color='Mode of Transportation') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent)
)

print(
  commuting_data_by_age_long %>%
    filter(!(CommuterType %in% c('Approximate Number of Cars', 'Non-Car'))) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = round(Commuters/DemographicCommuters, 2)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=Proportion, color=CommuterType)) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(~Demographic) +
    theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = 11)) +
    labs(color='Mode of Transportation') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent)
)

print(
  commuting_data_by_ethnicity_long %>%
    filter(!(CommuterType %in% c('Approximate Number of Cars', 'Non-Car'))) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = round(Commuters/DemographicCommuters, 2)) %>%

    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(~Demographic) +
    theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = 11)) +
    labs(color='Mode of Transportation') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent)
)
```
